Disclosure 306-2 Management of significant waste-related impacts

Disclosure 306-3 Waste generated
Additional sector recommendations
The following additional sector recommendations are for organizations in the
fishing sector:
• Report a breakdown of the total weight of waste generated on vessels to which
the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships
(MARPOL) is applicable by MARPOL categories in metric tons.21
• Describe the recovery and disposal operations used to manage each MARPOL
category of waste.
